A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same L2C-Insert study and contain complete, readable main text, Appendices A-I, and the checklist. Visual inspection resolved Figure 3's text-extraction artifacts in v1; no material comparison gaps remain.

before.justification: v1 reports original TSP and CVRP experiments in Section 4, including benchmark results and ablations, with additional empirical studies in Appendices D-F.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, ablations, hyperparameter studies, and construction examples in Section 4 and Appendices D-F.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain the same insertion architecture, supervised objective, local reconstruction procedure, and CVRP adaptations. Figure 3's typography changes do not alter the method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic TSP/CVRP coverage from 100 to 100K nodes and the same TSPLIB and CVRPLIB evaluations. No training or evaluation domain or scenario changes.

E2.justification: Corresponding tables retain identical comparator membership, including the classical and neural solvers, L2C-Append, and backbone comparisons. No comparator is added, removed, or substantively revised.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices C-E retain identical dataset sizes, preprocessing, training budgets, model configurations, inference settings, and Length/Gap/Time metrics.

E4.justification: The construction/destruction ablations in Section 4.2, hyperparameter studies in Appendix D, component and backbone analyses in Appendix E, and case studies in Appendix F are unchanged.

E5.justification: Checklist item 7 in both versions specifies seed=123 during training/inference and reports no error bars or statistical significance testing. No repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Results in Tables 1-12 and the construction examples match. For example, Table 1 retains the TSP1K L2C-Insert (I=1000) length of 23.230, gap of 0.481%, and runtime of 46.4m.

T1.justification: The problem definitions and Equations (1)-(12) are unchanged. Figure 3 displays mathematically equivalent conditional probabilities and loss notation; no assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical novelty, architecture, training, reconstruction, and TSP/CVRP performance and scalability claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning insertion flexibility, local optima, unvisited-node context, and decoder capacity are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations and proposed future extensions.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, and resource access information remain identical. Both checklists still state that code and trained models will be published upon acceptance.

R1.justification: The references and Appendix A's related-work discussion are identical, including the positioning of L2C-Insert relative to appending-based constructive and non-constructive methods.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin header changes from v1 dated 20 May 2025 to v2 dated 23 June 2025. Prose, terminology, headings, and section and appendix order are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 has small changes to mathematical typography, label placement, and spacing. Its training-flow content and caption remain unchanged; all other figures and tables are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The revision updates the version/date stamp and makes small presentation adjustments to Figure 3, which already conveyed the same readable training process. Scientific evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall quality.
